description: Write cells, typed: each item an address and exactly one of text (always literal, =x too), number, bool, date (YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm[:ss] or hh:mm; a General cell gets Excel's format, a number format needs format), formula (=D10*2), blank or markdown. One step; any refusal changes nothing. Afterwards every formula value reads cache invalidated: Excel recalculates on open. describe's writable is all you may write.

address.description: A cell with its sheet (Stock!D10), or a value by row key (t:stock/P-7/Quantity).

blank.description: true: remove the value, keep the format.

expect.description: The cell's type now, else refused.

expect_value.description: Its value now as read (dates YYYY-MM-DD), else refused.

format.description: A date format to give the cell: yyyy-mm-dd.

row.description: New key (t:...): the free capacity row it starts in.

replace_formulas.description: Write over cells holding a formula. Default false.

revision.description: The doc's version you read; refused if it changed.

name: xlsx_set_cells
